Package edu.acg.itss

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    CodeNameAllowedTerms
    auxiliary class used only for the display of desired courses.
    Course
    class is responsible for maintaining all relevant course data.
    CourseEditor
    class responsible for presenting a GUI for editing courses in the "cls.csv" main file living in a sub-directory of the root app directory, specified in the cmd-line of this program.
    CourseGroup
    class is responsible for describing groups from which student must take certain courses.
    CourseGroupEditor
    class is responsible for presenting a GUI for creating/updating/deleting course groups of any kind supported by the program.
    CurrentDate
    trivial class holds "current" day-of-month, month, and year, as specified by user.
    DesiredCourses
    maintains the courses the student has declared they want to take.
    MainGUI
    main entry point to the ACG SCORER application.
    MIPHandler
    class creates and handles the student course scheduling Mixed Integer Programming problem, passing it to a MIP solver (SCIP or GUROBI) to solve.
    PassedCourses
    maintains the courses the student has already passed.
    ProgramCodeStruct
    represents program codes to always attempt to maximize as last priority objective, and their possible exception groups.
    ScheduleParams
    maintains scheduling problem parameters.
